mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the well was most worthwhile: the heated jacket and raw-water strainer made the practical challenge of moving untreated water clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Starting the processor was straightforward, but the treatment stages and checks happened in one result, leaving little to figure out.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the extraction probe warmed the ice and brought a cloudy trickle to the collection head.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt arbitrary; each had a clear role in getting water from the ice to the tap.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see what the expedition builds next, though I would hope for more meaningful choices than the single available action at each step.
